examples.chinese: 明天是九月二十三號……啊！是妳的生日！
examples.pinyin: Míngtiān shì jiǔ yuè èrshísān hào... Ā! Shì nǐ de shēngrì!
examples.english: It is September 23rd tomorrow...Ah! It is your birthday!

items.wordHook: a 号(mark) brands the fierce 虎(tiger) → that 號(number) is yours.

examples.chinese: A：你今天早上有課嗎？ B：我今天早上沒有課。
examples.pinyin: A: Nǐ jīntiān zǎoshang yǒu kè ma? B: Wǒ jīntiān zǎoshang méi yǒu kè.
examples.english: A: Do you have class this morning? B: I don’t have class this morning.

examples.chinese: 你幾點下課？
examples.pinyin: Nǐ jǐ diǎn xiàkè?
examples.english: What time do you get out of class?

examples.chinese: 我四點四十分下課。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ sì diǎn sìshí fēn xiàkè.
examples.english: I get out of class at 4:40.

examples.chinese: 我下午有課，中午不回家。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ xiàwǔ yǒu kè, zhōngwǔ bù huí jiā.
examples.english: I have class in the afternoon; I am not coming home at noon.

examples.chinese: 我早上沒有課，九點去圖書館。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ zǎoshang méi yǒu kè, jiǔ diǎn qù túshūguǎn.
examples.english: I don’t have class in the morning. I am going to the library at 9:00.

examples.chinese: 我每個星期都有中文課。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ měi ge xīngqí dōu yǒu Zhōngwén kè.
examples.english: I have Chinese class every week.

examples.chinese: 王老師的課很有趣，每個學生都喜歡她。
examples.pinyin: Wáng lǎoshī de kè hěn yǒuqù, měi ge xuéshēng dōu xǐhuān tā.
examples.english: Teacher Wang’s class is very interesting; every student likes her.

examples.chinese: 啊！上課了！我們先上課吧。
examples.pinyin: A! Shàngkè le! Wǒmen xiān shàngkè ba.
examples.english: Ah! The class has started! Let’s go to class now.

examples.chinese: 我平常坐紅線去學校上課，週末也坐捷運去運動、看電影。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ píngcháng zuò hóng xiàn qù xuéxiào shàngkè, zhōumò yě zuò jiéyùn qù yùndòng, kàn diànyǐng.
examples.english: I usually go to school by the red one. On weekends I take it to exercise or see a movie as well.

examples.chinese: 這課真的不好學。
examples.pinyin: Zhè kè zhēnde bù hǎo xué.
examples.english: This chapter is really difficult to learn.

examples.chinese: 現在他在上書法課，我們四點去吧。
examples.pinyin: Xiànzài tā zài shàng shūfǎ kè, wǒmen sì diǎn qù ba.
examples.english: He is in the calligraphy class now. Let’s do it at 4 p.m.

examples.chinese: 可是從四點到五點半我要上英文課，六點去，怎麼樣？
examples.pinyin: Kěshì cóng sì diǎn dào wǔ diǎn bàn wǒ yào shàng Yīngwén kè, liù diǎn qù, zěnmeyàng?
examples.english: But I have an English class from 4 to 5:30 p.m. How about 6 p.m.?

examples.chinese: 好。我先回宿舍做功課，再跟你一起去找他。
examples.pinyin: Hǎo. Wǒ xiān huí sùshè zuò gōngkè, zài gēn nǐ yìqǐ qù zhǎo tā.
examples.english: Okay. I will go back to the dormitory to do my homework first, then I will go to see him with you.

examples.chinese: 這個學期開始，從星期一到星期五我都有華語課，每天從上午八點四十分到中午十二點上課，下午一點寫功課，有時候也跟同學練習說中文。
examples.pinyin: Zhè ge xuéqí kāishǐ, cóng xīngqí yī dào xīngqí wǔ, wǒ dōu yǒu Huáyǔ kè, měi tiān cóng shàngwǔ bā diǎn sìshí fēn dào zhōngwǔ shí’èr diǎn shàngkè, xiàwǔ yī diǎn xiě gōngkè, yǒushíhou yě gēn tóngxué liànxí shuō Zhōngwén.
examples.english: This semester I have Chinese class from 8:40 a.m. to 12:00 noon, Mondays to Fridays. I start to do my homework at 1:00 p.m., and sometimes I practice speaking Chinese with my classmates.

examples.chinese: 下個星期華語課有期中考，我有一點兒緊張，所以每天晚上都讀書，也練習寫字，希望下個星期的考試能考得很好。
examples.pinyin: Xià ge xīngqí Huáyǔ kè yǒu qízhōngkǎo, wǒ yǒu yìdiǎnr jǐnzhāng, suǒyǐ měi tiān wǎnshang dōu dúshū, yě liànxí xiězì, xīwàng xià ge xīngqí de kǎoshì néng kǎo de hěn hǎo.
examples.english: I will have the midterm exam for Chinese class next week. I am a bit nervous so I study every night and practice writing Chinese characters as well. I hope I can do well on the exam next week.

examples.chinese: 老師，國安今天要請假。他發燒了，不能來上課。
examples.pinyin: Lǎoshī, Guó'ān jīntiān yào qǐngjià. Tā fāshāo le, bù néng lái shàngkè.
examples.english: Teacher, Guoan has to take a leave today. He has a fever and he can’t come to school.

examples.chinese: 他打電話跟我說，他不能來上課，請我幫他請假。
examples.pinyin: Tā dǎ diànhuà gēn wǒ shuō, tā bù néng lái shàngkè, qǐng wǒ bāng tā qǐngjià.
examples.english: He gave me a call and told me that he couldn’t make it to class and asked me to ask for a leave for him.

examples.chinese: 他說他會去看醫生，請我們不要擔心，如果他好了，就會來學校上課。
examples.pinyin: Tā shuō tā huì qù kàn yīshēng, qǐng wǒmen bú yào dānxīn, rúguǒ tā hǎo le, jiù huì lái xuéxiào shàngkè.
examples.english: He said he will go see a doctor and he does not want to worry us. If he feels better, he will come to school.

examples.chinese: 今天我要帶一些水果去看他，也會跟他說今天的功課。
examples.pinyin: Jīntiān wǒ yào dài yìxiē shuǐguǒ qù kàn tā, yě huì gēn tā shuō jīntiān de gōngkè.
examples.english: Today, I am going to take some fruit to visit him and also inform him about the homework today.

examples.chinese: 我們都希望他明天能回學校上課。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen dōu xīwàng tā míngtiān néng huí xuéxiào shàngkè.
examples.english: We all hope he can come back to school tomorrow.

examples.chinese: 我們下個星期要學第十五課，我剛才先看了一點兒，書上有很多種動物，我覺得很有意思。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen xià ge xīngqí yào xué dì shíwǔ kè, wǒ gāngcái xiān kàn le yìdiǎnr, shū shàng yǒu hěn duō zhǒng dòngwù, wǒ juéde hěn yǒuyìsi.
examples.english: We are going to learn lesson fifteen next week. I previewed a bit earlier just now. There are many kinds of animals in the book; I think it is very interesting.

examples.chinese: 我記得有羊、馬、兔子……，最特別的是龍。（打開課本）妳看看……
examples.pinyin: Wǒ jìdé yǒu yáng, mǎ, tùzi..., zuì tèbié de shì lóng. (dǎkāi kèběn) Nǐ kànkan...
examples.english: I remember there are goats, horses, rabbits..., and the most special one is the dragon. (Open the textbook) You see...

examples.chinese: 這個孩子飯吃得太少了，你有什麼好辦法？
examples.pinyin: Zhège háizi fàn chī de tài shǎo le, nǐ yǒu shénme hǎo bànfǎ?
examples.english: This child eats too little food; do you have any good method?

examples.chinese: 那個老人年紀太大，沒辦法一個人生活。
examples.pinyin: Nàge lǎorén niánjì tài dà, méi bànfǎ yīgè rén shēnghuó.
examples.english: That old man is too old; he has no way to live by himself.

examples.chinese: 小孩子的手比較沒有力，沒辦法拿很重的東西。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎoháizi de shǒu bǐjiào méiyǒu lì, méi bànfǎ ná hěn zhòng de dōngxi.
examples.english: Children's hands have relatively little strength; they have no way to carry very heavy things.

examples.chinese: 雖然陸先生這幾年工作機會不斷，但是因為身體不好的關係一直沒辦法去上班。
黃先生這幾天一直發燒，腦子很不清楚，恐怕沒辦法寫劇本。
聽說經理後天就要離開公司了。 這個消息太突然了，大家一時沒辦法接受。
這次的水災不僅淹了整條街，好幾家工廠也因為淹水沒辦法生產，真是太糟了！
因為水災的關係，許多學校沒辦法正常上課，甚至連便利商店都關了。
那位老太太年紀大了，沒辦法照顧他的狗，所以想幫狗找個新主人。
這次的露營活動因為颱風辦不成了，可以說計畫永遠沒辦法趕上變化
那班飛機因為天氣的關係，沒辦法準時抵達
孩子是父母最親愛的寶貝，父母對他們的愛是沒辦法用文字來形容的。
博物館裡的東西非常寶貴， 它們具有民族和文化的價值， 沒辦法用錢算清楚的
因為學校缺乏經費，宿舍的電腦設備暫時沒辦法改善。
這座地下停車場因為缺乏經費，沒辦法改善又暗又溼的情形。
到地震災區救災的軍人們，這幾天忙得連一頓飯都沒辦法好好地吃。
科學家早就證明了氣溫的變化對農業生產有不好的影響，可是到目前還找不到解決的好辦法。
那家工廠的設備及員工都嚴重缺乏，哪裡有辦法進一步發展？
他一直熱愛翻譯工作，不論多困難都會想辦法克服。
看見有困難的人們，有能力的話就得想辦法幫助他們，不應該不理他們。
一失眠就吃藥不是好辦法，最好跟醫生談談，試著找出原因。
我想了許多辦法去達成公司的目標，卻還是得不到主管的支持。
這件事我根本不了解，所以沒辦法給你適當的建議。
解決種族之間因文化差異產生的問題，最好的辦法就是互相尊重。
我週末還要工作，打算一下班就去看燈會。我們可以約友美一起去。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ zhōumò hái yào gōngzuò, dǎsuàn yí xiàbān jiù qù kàn dēnghuì. Wǒmen kěyǐ yuē Yǒuměi yìqǐ qù.
examples.english: I have to work on weekends, and plan to go to the Lantern Carnival as soon as I get off from work. We can ask Youmei out for the Lantern Carnival together.

items.wordHook: She knots a 糹(silk) thread around a 勺(spoon) and waits → a firm 約(appointment).

examples.chinese: 請給我一杯綠茶。
examples.pinyin: Qǐng gěi wǒ yì bēi lǜchá.
examples.english: Please give me a cup of green tea.

examples.chinese: 我會給你三天的藥。你要記得多喝一點兒水，要是發燒了，就吃紅色的藥。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ huì gěi nǐ sān tiān de yào. Nǐ yào jìde duō hē yìdiǎnr shuǐ, yàoshi fāshāo le, jiù chī hóngsè de yào.
examples.english: I will give you medicine for 3 days. Remember to drink plenty of water. If you have a fever, then take the red pill.

examples.chinese: 請給我們一杯紅茶、一杯綠茶。請問一共多少錢？
examples.pinyin: Qǐng gěi wǒmen yì bēi hóngchá, yì bēi lǜchá. Qǐngwèn yígòng duōshǎo qián?
examples.english: We would to have a cup of black tea and a cup of green tea. How much does that cost altogether?

items.wordHook: a 糹(silk) thread holds the 合(join) of two hands → to 給(give).

examples.chinese: 這些碗筷、刀叉我都還沒擦乾，不可以給客人用。
examples.pinyin: Zhèxiē wǎnkuài, dāochā wǒ dōu hái méi cā gān, bù kěyǐ gěi kèrén yòng.
examples.english: I haven't dried these bowls, chopsticks, and cutlery yet; they can't be given to guests to use.

examples.chinese: 暑假的時候，我跟弟弟一起做家事。我掃地，他洗碗筷。
examples.pinyin: Shǔjià de shíhou, wǒ gēn dìdi yīqǐ zuò jiāshì. Wǒ sǎo dì, tā xǐ wǎnkuài.
examples.english: During summer vacation, I do housework together with my younger brother. I sweep the floor, and he washes the dishes.

examples.chinese: 昨天洗的衣服乾了沒有？這些碗筷、刀叉我都還沒擦乾，不可以給客人用。
examples.pinyin: Zuótiān xǐ de yīfu gān le méiyǒu? Zhèxiē wǎnkuài, dāochā wǒ dōu hái méi cā gān, bù kěyǐ gěi kèrén yòng.
examples.english: Are the clothes washed yesterday dry yet? I haven't dried these bowls, chopsticks, and cutlery yet; they can't be given to guests to use.

examples.chinese: 他把全部的碗筷都擦乾了，可以給客人用了。
examples.pinyin: Tā bǎ quánbù de wǎnkuài dōu cā gān le, kěyǐ gěi kèrén yòng le.
examples.english: He wiped all the bowls and chopsticks dry; they can be used for the guests now.

examples.chinese: [{"chinese":"我把剛買回來的小說擺在書架上。","pinyin":"","english":""},{"chinese":"準備吃飯了，快點兒把碗筷擺好！","pinyin":"","english":""}]
examples.pinyin: Wǒ bǎ gāng mǎi huílái de xiǎoshuō bǎi zài shūjià shàng. Zhǔnbèi chīfàn le, kuài diǎnr bǎ wǎnkuài bǎi hǎo!
examples.english: I placed the novel I just bought on the bookshelf. We're getting ready to eat; quickly set out the bowls and chopsticks!

examples.chinese: 室友A:嘿，吃完飯後不能把碗筷擺在桌子讓別人洗喔。室友B:不好意思，我這就去洗。室友A:嘿，你還真聽話(obedient)啊。
在這家餐廳，沒有人替你服務，點菜、拿碗筷等一切都得自助。
上樓、下樓的時候都不要急，小心走。
examples.pinyin: Shàng lóu, xià lóu de shíhòu dōu bùyào jí, xiǎoxīn zǒu.
examples.english: When going upstairs or downstairs, don't be in a hurry; walk carefully.

examples.chinese: 那位客人的錢包丟了，非常著急。
examples.pinyin: Nà wèi kèrén de qiánbāo diū le, fēicháng zháojí.
examples.english: That customer's wallet was lost, and he is very anxious.

examples.chinese: [{"chinese":"陳先生在醫院裡著急地等待小孩出生。","pinyin":"","english":""},{"chinese":"有些人等待了一輩子，都等不到高升的機會。","pinyin":"","english":""}]
examples.pinyin: Chén xiānsheng zài yīyuàn lǐ zháojí de děngdài xiǎohái chūshēng. Yǒuxiē rén děngdài le yíbèizi, dōu děng bú dào gāoshēng de jīhuì.
examples.english: Mr. Chen is anxiously waiting in the hospital for his child to be born. Some people wait their whole life and never get a chance for promotion.

examples.chinese: 媽媽對哥哥說，以他現在剛上班的情況，不能急著買房子，得等錢存夠了再買。
你先別急著買，貨比三家不吃虧，多看幾家再決定吧！
A:醫生，我求你快救救我的貓。 B:別急！我馬上檢查。
林阿姨來我家推銷保險，我不好意思當面拒絕她，只好假裝有急事要出門。
某年某月的某一天，你會找到心中最理想的結婚對象，現在別急。
小張已經四十歲了，父母盼望他快點找到結婚對象，他卻一點也不著急。
鄰居有急事得出門處理，請我暫時幫他照顧孩子。
A:我到底該怎麼做才能讓老闆滿意？ B:你太驕傲、個性太急， 做事也不夠仔細。總之， 先把自己的缺點改掉吧。
我有很急的事找張先生，請他到辦公室後回電，謝謝。
這份文件很急，請你下班以前傳真給對方公司。
老闆說，除了緊急情況，下班時間別打電話找他。
在臺灣，碰到緊急情況可撥110，請警察提供協助。
當你急著需要某個物品時，不管划不划算，都非買不可。
用過一面的紙張別急著丟，另一面也可以用。
夏天的時候，芒果冰、西瓜汁的生意好得不得了！
examples.pinyin: Xiàtiān de shíhou, mángguǒ bīng, xīguā zhī de shēngyì hǎo de bùdéliǎo!
examples.english: In summer, the business of mango shaved ice and watermelon juice is extremely good!

examples.chinese: 李小姐趁出國時，在機場買了一瓶有名的香水。
examples.pinyin: Lǐ xiǎojiě chèn chūguó shí, zài jīchǎng mǎi le yī píng yǒumíng de xiāngshuǐ.
examples.english: Ms. Li, while taking advantage of going abroad, bought a bottle of famous perfume at the airport.

examples.chinese: 有人喜歡在枕頭上抹一點兒自己喜歡的香水，聽說可以紓壓。
我平常早上七點起床，八點吃早飯。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ píngcháng zǎoshang qī diǎn qǐchuáng, bā diǎn chī zǎofàn.
examples.english: I usually get up at seven and have breakfast at eight in the morning.

examples.chinese: 我跟媽媽明天下午要一起去看電影。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ gēn māma míngtiān xiàwǔ yào yìqǐ qù kàn diànyǐng.
examples.english: Mom and I are going to see a movie tomorrow afternoon.

examples.chinese: 這個週末我們一起去看海，怎麼樣？
examples.pinyin: Zhè ge zhōumò wǒmen yìqǐ qù kàn hǎi, zěnmeyàng?
examples.english: How about going to watch the sea this weekend?

examples.chinese: 我跟同學常常一起在學校打網球。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ gēn tóngxué chángcháng yìqǐ zài xuéxiào dǎ wǎngqiú.
examples.english: My classmates and I often play tennis together at the school.

examples.chinese: 我和朋友常常一起去吃冰淇淋。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ hé péngyǒu chángcháng yìqǐ qù chī bīngqílín.
examples.english: My friends and I often go have ice cream together.

examples.chinese: 我們常常一起去圖書館。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen chángcháng yìqǐ qù túshūguǎn.
examples.english: We often go to the library together.

examples.chinese: 好啊，我們一起吃蛋糕。
examples.pinyin: Hǎo ā, wǒmen yìqǐ chī dàngāo.
examples.english: Great, let’s eat the cake together.

examples.chinese: 昨天我們一起去圖書館。
examples.pinyin: Zuótiān wǒmen yìqǐ qù túshūguǎn.
examples.english: We went to the library together yesterday.

examples.chinese: 我今天七點起床。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ jīntiān qī diǎn qǐchuáng.
examples.english: I get up at 7:00 today.

examples.chinese: 我週末還要工作，打算一下班就去看燈會。我們可以約友美一起去。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ zhōumò hái yào gōngzuò, dǎsuàn yí xiàbān jiù qù kàn dēnghuì. Wǒmen kěyǐ yuē Yǒuměi yìqǐ qù.
examples.english: I have to work on weekends, and plan to go to the Lantern Carnival as soon as I get off from work. We can ask Youmei out for the Lantern Carnival together.

examples.pinyin: Tóngshì dōu zǒu le, zhǐ shèngxià tā yí ge rén hái zài zuòshì. Tā shì guǎnggào gōngsī de jīnglǐ, měitiān yào zuò hǎo duō shì, máng de bùdéliǎo.
examples.english: The colleagues have all left; only he is left still working. He is a manager at an advertising company; every day he has to do a lot of work and is incredibly busy.

examples.chinese: 張經理不但常加班，還要做市場研究，每天都忙得不得了。
examples.pinyin: Zhāng jīnglǐ bùdàn cháng jiābān, hái yào zuò shìchǎng yánjiū, měitiān dōu máng de bùdéliǎo.
examples.english: Manager Zhang not only often works overtime but also has to do market research; every day he is incredibly busy.

examples.chinese: 我父親是保險公司的經理，要管理很多員工。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ fùqīn shì bǎoxiǎn gōngsī de jīnglǐ, yào guǎnlǐ hěn duō yuángōng.

examples.english: I am Boss Chen's assistant; every day I have to report the company's situation to him.

examples.english: A nurse's job is to help doctors deal with patients' problems.
